# Platform gaps

> Generated from `capabilities.index.json`, `specifications/audit-findings.json`, and `specifications/consumer-demand.json`. Do not edit by hand.

## Explicit P0-P4 gaps

### P0 — gap.browser.bulk-overlay-duplicate-owner

- Capability: `browser.features.overlays`
- Reported by: metafor/@quantum/bulk/quantum/bulk DOM overlay — HUD composition over the existing 3D scene
- Expected: The consumer creates a shared browser-owned overlay and supplies its exact Document/root/style contract.
- Actual: Bulk directly constructs CPU Renderer and WebGPU backend and reimplements pointer mapping, hit, pointer capture, touch suppression and lifecycle.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/browser-host
- Minimal source: Compare Bulk overlay-runtime ownership with RendererBrowserSpaceRuntime.addOverlay.
- Recommended conformance test: A package-boundary test should reject direct @zavx0z/renderer and renderer-webgpu imports from the Bulk DOM consumer.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Keeping consumer-owned pointer capture; Copying RendererBrowserSpaceRuntime behavior

### P0 — gap.engine.browser-document-ownership

- Capability: `engine.features.browser-document-boundary`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/Document-bound browser composition — secondary Document or canvas runtime
- Expected: Engine receives host-neutral inputs/resources; browser document/canvas/listener ownership stays in renderer-browser.
- Actual: ViewPoint now has a listener-free host mode with explicit client viewport, but default browser controls still accept/mutate HTMLElement state and Renderer.init still owns an HTMLCanvasElement/GPUCanvasContext boundary.
- Owner: engine/@engine/core/public-boundary
- Minimal source: Create ViewPoint for an element in a secondary Document and inspect listener owner and restored touchAction after disposal.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert listeners bind ownerDocument and browser state is restored or entirely browser-owner controlled.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Monkey-patching global document; Duplicating browser listeners in components

### P0 — gap.engine.css-layout-ownership

- Capability: `engine.features.dom-css-ownership-boundary`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer/platform ownership law — Engine public Object3D surface
- Expected: Engine public objects contain only scene, GPU and resource state; DOM/CSS layout semantics remain in CPU Renderer.
- Actual: Object3D publicly exposes layout/computedLayout and @engine/core exports CSS-like flex/sizing/gap/padding/margin types.
- Owner: engine/@engine/core/public-boundary
- Minimal source: Import LayoutProps or assign Object3D.layout from @engine/core.
- Recommended conformance test: A package-boundary test should reject DOM/CSS semantic exports from Engine.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Moving CSS computation into materials; Creating a second layout tree on Object3D

### P0 — gap.engine.index-buffer-format

- Capability: `engine.features.index-buffer-format`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-webgpu/Engine draw ABI — Uint8 or invalid index attribute
- Expected: Only Uint16/Uint32 index buffers reach GPU submission and their declared format matches the underlying data.
- Actual: BufferGeometry accepts arbitrary TypedArray indices and GLTF admits UNSIGNED_BYTE, while Renderer binds every non-Uint32 index as uint16 without validation.
- Owner: engine/@engine/core/geometry-upload
- Minimal source: Create geometry with Uint8Array or Float32Array indices and submit it.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert construction fails closed before GPU submission or binds a valid matching index representation.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Renderer consumers recasting private geometry; Ignoring GPU validation errors

### P0 — gap.engine.renderer-resource-teardown

- Capability: `engine.features.renderer-disposal`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/browser runtime cleanup — dispose a complete canvas/plane runtime
- Expected: Disposing the Engine renderer releases device-owned buffers, attachments, cached texture/text resources, callbacks and subscriptions exactly once.
- Actual: Renderer exposes geometry invalidation but no whole-owner dispose; TextureLoader caches/listeners and evicted Text GPU buffers have no complete teardown path.
- Owner: engine/@engine/core/resource-lifecycle
- Minimal source: Create a renderer, materialize text/images/pipelines, dispose the browser runtime and inspect retained Engine cache/resource owners.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert all owner resources and callbacks are released exactly once.
- Dependencies: `gap.engine.texture-cache-device-identity`
- Forbidden local workarounds: Browser runtime reaching into private Engine maps; Component-owned GPU resource destruction

### P0 — gap.engine.texture-cache-device-identity

- Capability: `engine.features.texture-device-identity`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-webgpu/image materialization — same source is requested on two GPUDevice owners
- Expected: Every cached GPUTexture and fallback texture belongs to the exact GPUDevice that created it.
- Actual: TextureLoader caches by src and one process-global fallback; a second device can receive the first device's texture.
- Owner: engine/@engine/core/texture-resource
- Minimal source: Request the fallback or same src from fake device A and then fake device B.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert each device creates and receives its own texture; current code returns A's texture to B.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Source URL rewriting in consumers; Renderer-owned duplicate texture cache

### P0 — gap.renderer.backend-neutral-diagnostics

- Capability: `renderer.features.backend-neutral-diagnostics`
- Reported by: demo/@zavx0z/demo/journal diagnostics — observe retained presentation owner count
- Expected: A consumer reads a neutral documented diagnostic or does not inspect backend internals.
- Actual: Demo reads journalPlane.backend.root.children directly, exposing retained WebGPU/Engine owner objects to product code.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer/diagnostics
- Minimal source: Run the Demo journal plane subscription and inspect the dataset write.
- Recommended conformance test: A consumer-boundary test should reject backend/root/Engine object reads from product code.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Casting private backend fields; Exporting Engine Object3D to components

### P1 — gap.dom.geometry-readback

- Capability: `dom.extensions.cssom-view.interfaces.element.methods.getboundingclientrect`
- Reported by: interpreter/@metafor/interpreter/SourceEditor scrollToLine — scroll a rendered line into view
- Expected: A semantic Element can read the current CPU Renderer box without creating a second tree.
- Actual: Current canonical DOM has no getBoundingClientRect/readComputedStyle realm bridge; SourceEditor uses line*16 and a fixed 220px viewport.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/dom/renderer-backed-read
- Minimal source: Change source-editor font size/line height and invoke scrollToLine.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert scrolling uses the current rendered line box rather than a constant.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Hard-coded line height; A component-owned layout tree

### P1 — gap.tsx.consumer-build-migration

- Capability: `tsx.compiler.browser-target-build`
- Reported by: interpreter/@metafor/interpreter/compiled component consumers — linked @ui/components exports now resolve to .tsx
- Expected: Consumer build configurations compile governed TSX and mount compiled components through @zavx0z/react.
- Actual: Demo, Interpreter and MetaFor visual consumers lack JSX compiler settings and still import removed create*Controller APIs.
- Owner: interpreter/@metafor/interpreter/consumer-build
- Minimal source: Run current Demo/Interpreter/@internal/visual/Bulk typechecks against linked @ui/components.
- Recommended conformance test: Expect no TS6142 and no imports of removed imperative controllers after the consumer migration.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Restoring create*Controller exports; Adding a second JSX runtime

### P2 — gap.css.linked-author-import

- Capability: `css.at-rules.at-import`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/native linked author theme — an explicitly supplied loaded theme contains @import or @font-face
- Expected: A linked author stylesheet either carries imported/resource rules through their true owners or rejects the complete source before semantic publication.
- Actual: The bounded host accepts flat CSSStyleRule records only and fails closed for @import, @font-face and other at-rules; it performs no second fetch and owns no Engine font loader.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/browser-host
- Minimal source: Pass an exact loaded link whose cssRules contain CSSImportRule or CSSFontFaceRule to the linked author stylesheet host.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert host.ready/refresh rejects and no partial author snapshot is published.
- Dependencies: `css.at-rules.at-font-face`
- Forbidden local workarounds: A second consumer fetch of the same CSS URL; Copying imported rules or font declarations into component CSS

### P2 — gap.css.linked-author-nesting

- Capability: `css.features.nesting`
- Reported by: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer-browser/native linked author theme — an explicitly supplied theme contains nested selectors
- Expected: Nested rules preserve parent selector expansion, source order, specificity and pseudo behavior before semantic cascade.
- Actual: The current CPU parser admits flat rules only; the linked host detects nested CSSStyleRule blocks and rejects the source atomically rather than flattening them incorrectly.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer/cpu
- Minimal source: Load a configured link containing button { &:hover { color:red } }.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert refresh rejects with a nesting diagnostic and retains the previous exact snapshot.
- Dependencies: none
- Forbidden local workarounds: Regex flattening in a component or Storybook consumer; Silently dropping nested pseudo rules

### P3 — gap.css.theme-math-functions

- Capability: `css.functions.clamp-function`
- Reported by: ui/@ui/components/foundation theme dimensional tokens — a component dimension uses min(), max(), clamp() or mixed-unit calc
- Expected: Theme dimensions evaluate supported CSS math with compatible unit algebra and containing-block resolution.
- Actual: Bounded calc() supports one compatible number/px/percent/resolved-em result; min(), max(), clamp() and mixed percent-plus-pixel sums reject instead of approximating.
- Owner: renderer/@zavx0z/renderer/computed
- Minimal source: Set width:min(10px,20px), height:max(...), clamp(...) and calc(100% - 4px) on a semantic Element.
- Recommended conformance test: Assert current computed dimensions are absent and a future implementation resolves each without component-local arithmetic.
- Dependencies: `css.functions.min-function`, `css.functions.max-function`
- Forbidden local workarounds: Computing layout tokens in component JavaScript; Treating mixed units as pixels
